frames.gloss: A 被认为与 B 存在关联（多指健康风险的统计关联）。
frames.notes: 健康/科普报道的高频被动框架：has/have been linked to + 结果（风险、收益、结论）。学习者易按主动义『连接』理解而丢失被动统计含义，也易忽略 linked to 与 linked with 可互换。

examples.text: Fruit juice also has been linked to claims that it can help you both lose weight and stay healthy.
Diets high in fibre have been linked to a lower risk of developing heart disease, stroke, high blood pressure and diabetes, and it’s recommended adults consume 30g per day.
Not only has red meat been linked to cancer, but studies show that people who ditch meat have lower blood pressure, l ower average blood sugar, and lower cholesterol levels.

frames.frame: [A方 did X], while [B方] would have (preferred/liked) [Y]
frames.gloss: A 方（事实）如何如何，而我本会更想要 Y——隐含对过去的虚拟对比。
frames.notes: while 连接对比双方，后接 would have + 过去分词，虚拟条件（如果我可以选择）隐含在上下文，全句无 if。学习者易把 would have preferred 读成一般过去『当时更喜欢』，丢失反事实义。

examples.text: They favored a more rigid, closed-door, corporate atmosphere, while I would have preferred something more collaborative and open.
They were complete clock watchers, while I would have liked a more flexible schedule.

frames.related: Whereas/while 对比从句（前置/句尾）

frames.notes: what 引导的名词性从句：what + 形式主语 it + 介词 like（『像什么样』）。like 是介词不是动词，学习者易误读为『喜欢』；常出现在 ask/reveal/tell about 之后，问询或揭示真实体验。

examples.text: So yes, you can definitely ask your interviewer about what it's like to work for that particular organization.

Simple questions like, “What three words would you use to describe the culture here?” or “What's your favorite part about working for this company?can reveal a lot about what it's really like behind closed doors.

frames.gloss: 你有什么……？（自省式设问，but 后常省略宾语）
frames.notes: what 作主语的口语化反思问句：What’s something you + 定语从句，后接 but 时从句宾语常省略（aren’t good at = aren’t good at it；gave up = gave it up）。学习者易因成分省略而读断句或找不到 at 的宾语。

examples.text: Think about it: what’s something you ’ve always wanted to do, but gave up because you “don’t have the skills for it”?
What’s something you love but aren’t good at?

frames.notes: there be + 名词 + for + NP + 被动不定式：to be V-ed 是被动关系的非谓语，中国学习者常漏掉被动或误读为主动；need/potential 槽决定语义方向（必要性 vs 可能性）。

examples.text: When debates in any sector move beyond the halls of universities and government agencies, there's potential for information to be used incorrectly, leading to public confusion; yet, open debate can also promote communication between the scientific community and the public.
With the validity of science coming under attack, there's a need for scientific debates to be perceived as open and true to life.

candidates.frame: just because [S V] doesn’t mean [S V]
candidates.notes: just because 从句做主语的整体用法（because 从句名词化），主句用 doesn’t mean。本批仅 1 例，但价值高：学习者易把 just because 当原因状语、找不到主句主语。

examples.text: However, just because it ’s plant-based doesn’t mean i t’s health food.

candidates.frame: [A] be different from [B] in that [S V]
candidates.gloss: A 与 B 的不同之处在于……（in that = 因为/在于）。
candidates.notes: in that 引导的限定从句表『差异所在/原因』，是书面正式语域的固定搭配。本批仅 1 例；学习者常把 in that 误拆为介词短语。

examples.text: Fruit juice is different from whole fruit in that it contains much less fibre.

candidates.gloss: 若不是如此，……本会（无法）……（隐含虚拟）。
candidates.notes: otherwise 承担虚拟条件（= if it were not for the present case），would otherwise 后接动词原形或 not be able to。本批仅 1 例；学习者易把 otherwise 只当『否则』读而丢掉虚拟义。

examples.text: Offering online classes certainly helps students who would otherwise not be able to attend classroom sessions.

candidates.frame: It should come as no surprise (to [sb]) that [S V]
candidates.notes: it 外置主语 + come as no surprise 固定搭配 + that 从句。本批仅 1 例；学习者易读慢 it 的归属和 come as 的搭配。

examples.text: So, it should come as no surprise to anyone that classical music pieces are still used as background music in modern movies.

candidates.frame: there are few [N] that are more [A] (than [B])
candidates.gloss: 几乎没有什么比……更……（隐性最高级的低调陈述）。
candidates.notes: few + 比较级的反说式最高级：『很少有更……的』≈ 『几乎是最……的』。本批仅 1 例；学习者易按字面读成否定句。

examples.text: Fans of classical music can also tell you that there are few types of music that are more expressive.

candidates.frame: Now comes the part/time when [S V]
candidates.notes: 叙事推进句：Now comes + 单数名词 + when 定语从句，主谓倒装（comes 在主语前）。本批仅 1 例；学习者易把倒装读成疑问或断错主语。

examples.text: Now comes the part when you put on your detective hat and do a little digging.

candidates.gloss: 你知道那种……的时候吗？（唤起共同经验的口语设问）
candidates.notes: 口语框架：You know that + 场景名词 + when 定语从句（关系副词 when 修饰 part/time 类名词），句末问号但功能是共鸣而非真提问。本批仅 1 例。

examples.text: You know that part at the end of a job interview when the hiring manager asks if you have any questions, and you just stare across the table blankly with your mouth hanging open?

candidates.frame: be as much of a [A] as a [B]
candidates.gloss: 既是 B 同样也是 A（好坏并置的持平评价）。
candidates.notes: as much of a + 名词 + as + 名词：『与……一样程度上是……』，常用于 curse/blessing 等对立词并置，表利弊各半。本批仅 1 例。

examples.text: Outer beauty can be as much of a curse as a blessing.

candidates.gloss: （某事发生/被完成）需要多长时间。
candidates.notes: It takes + 时间 + for + 逻辑主语 + to do：与已登记的『It takes sb time to V』不同，这里时间后直接接 for 引出对象，对象可为被动（for cells to be digested）。本批干净例句仅 1 例（另一例为两种结构混用）。

examples.text: It takes some time for fruit’s cells to be digested and for fructose to be absorbed.

candidates.gloss: ……是有原因的（为零连词定语从句）。
candidates.notes: reason 后省略 why/that 的定语从句：There’s a reason (why) S V。本批仅 1 例；学习者易在 reason 后找不到连词而读断。

examples.text: There’s a reason tailored jackets are associated with being “dressed for success”.

candidates.notes: with the rise of + 名词做句首伴随状语引出历史变迁，主句多为『旧事物衰落/新格局出现』。本批仅 1 例。

examples.text: With the rise of pop music, jazz, and electronic music, both opera and classical music started to fade away from the public eye.
